d:
Thousands of INDIA bloc supporters gathered in Delhi for the ‘Chalo Dilli’ march and mega rally at Ramlila Maidan. Led by Rahul Gandhi and joined by leaders including Akhilesh Yadav and Mamata Banerjee, the Opposition is protesting alleged electoral irregularities, opposing the SIR exercise and demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation.
